# Minecraft Life Journal (MLJ) — mlj.app

> Minecraft Life Journal (MLJ) is a zero-modding desktop companion and web application created by SamXop123 that automatically tracks, logs, and preserves Minecraft survival world stories, playtime, advancements, screenshot memories, and coordinates.

## Key Features
- **Zero Modding Required**: Works with vanilla Minecraft and standard launchers (Official Minecraft Launcher, Fabric, Forge, Quilt).
- **MLJ Companion App**: Lightweight Rust/Tauri desktop application (0% idle CPU) that monitors game processes, session playtime, and screenshot directories.
- **In-Game Chat Commands**:
  - `#journal <message>` — Instantly creates a timeline memory entry in the web journal.
  - `#coords <label> <X> <Y> <Z>` — Saves points of interest (bases, portals, villages, strongholds) to interactive world maps.
- **Automatic Screenshot Matcher**: Automatically pairs F2 screenshots taken within 60 seconds of a chat entry with the timeline note.
- **Public Share Links**: Users can generate public showcase links (`https://mlj.app/share/<token>`) to share world timelines with friends.
